name: Avellino (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Avellino (a lamb with a banner on light blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Avellino, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Avellino arms — lamb with a banner on light blue, crowned, within branches
